text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Why do Umamusume festivals exist alongside 
humans?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—The time to embark on this learning has 
arrived for me.

Summoned by Azuma-san on this day, we 
arrived at 
a narrow trail winding deep into the 
forest.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
This is the path to the sacred mountain, 
known only to 
the shrine maidens presiding over the 
Goshiki Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Shinjikoma-sama, Shinkoma-sama, 
Trainer-sama. 
...Please watch your footing.

I follow behind Azuma-san as she leads the 
way. 
Does the "answer" lie ahead of us?

"Why did humans come to be involved 
in the sacred rites of Umamusume?" 
—The answer to that question.
(Crunch, crunch, crunch...)

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Next, take the hidden path to the left.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: We cross here.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Straight ahead.

Just how many hours have we been walking? 
No matter how much I wipe it away, sweat 
pours out, 
and my vision gradually blurs.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-sama.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I hear you took Shinkoma-sama to the 
museum 
in order to deepen your knowledge and 
bond.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And that you traveled all the way to the 
Soma Nomaoi as well.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
......And seeing all of that, 
<chrname>-sama, as the Shinjikoma, 
undoubtedly watched you closely.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And <chrname>-sama has devoted herself 
faithfully to the rehearsals for the 
Goshiki Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Together, you have studied various 
teachings, deepened them, sublimated 
them...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...<chrname>-sama has grown remarkably strong.
choice_data_list:
Yes, compared to a year ago... so much 
stronger...!

text_block_list.text:
Hearing <chrname>, my charge, being praised, 
I felt a surge of renewed strength begin 
to well up.

At this rate, I can make it all the way. 
Just one more step, and another step after 
that—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-sama. 
At the summit of this mountain stands a 
stone monument 
engraved with an ancient legend.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
A legend that holds the answer to 
"Why Umamusume festivals exist alongside 
humans."
choice_data_list: Then I... definitely have to see it...!

text_block_list.text:
Our goal seems to be just a little further 
ahead. 
Breathe. ————... Breathe.

...My knees are shaking, the world is 
wobbling. 
Even though... it's just a little 
further...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Yet this journey is 
far, steep... far too grueling.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: May you.

—In that moment, I felt something warm 
touch me.
...<chrname>'s back?

I try to pull away from <chrname>. 
Yet, <chrname> pulls me back firmly.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
......Indeed, <chrname>-sama. 
Once Trainer-sama's safety is assured, 
let us proceed.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: To fulfill his wish.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: To fulfill her wish.
—I can hear the sound of the wind.

Where am I? 
The bleached scenery gradually comes into 
focus. 
And then...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Morning☆

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
ーーー! You're awake! 
Trainer's awake, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Your pulse remains stable as well. 
Can you sit up, Trainer-sama?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
We are at the summit of the sacred 
mountain.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>-sama rallied everyone 
and carried you all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
That's our Shinjikoma and everyone's 
leader for ya!
choice_data_list: T-Thank you! All of you, too...!
T-Thank you so much! All of you, too...!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-sama. 
The stone monument is over there.

As if having waited eagerly for me, 
<chrname> begins walking toward the stone monument.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we read it together?

I stood beside <chrname> and looked at the stone 
monument. 
Inscribed upon it was...

...Engraved there was the tale of a 
solitary horsegirl.

Since time immemorial, horsegirls had 
loved to run. 
Among them, one girl harbored a fierce 
yearning: 
"To run faster... and faster still."

Then one day, she met a human. 
Upon seeing the horsegirl, the human was 
filled with wonder.
"I have never seen anyone run so swiftly!"

Whenever time permitted, the human would 
come 
to watch the horsegirl run. 
Marveling at how fast, and how far, she 
could go.

The horsegirl, in turn, did not mind the 
human's company. 
At times, she even found herself waiting 
for their arrival. But then—

A terrible plague descended upon the 
village.

The human she knew lay collapsed in the 
wilderness. 
Spotting the horsegirl, they pleaded in a 
faint, trembling whisper: 
..."Please, deliver this letter to the 
neighboring village."

"With your speed, I know you can make it 
in time." 
—In time for what? The looming shadow of 
death 
made her stiffen with fear. But still... 
still...!

They had told her she could do it. 
...They had seen boundless dreams in her 
legs.

In that moment, it is said a strange, 
boundless power 
welled up within the horsegirl.
choice_data_list: ..."And truly swift did that maiden run."

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
"Thus did the maiden deliver the missive 
to the human village." 
It seems the letter was safely handed to 
someone skilled in medicine.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
From that day forth, it is said that the 
bond between 
that horsegirl—and indeed, all 
horsegirls—and humans 
grew ever deeper.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps they simply never wanted to 
forget. 
The day their lives intertwined with 
humans, when they felt the prayers 
of those who dreamed upon them—and a new 
power awoke within.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...What are your thoughts on this, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Do you believe it to be true? 
That just like with that horsegirl... 
human prayers grant horsegirls strength?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Then your eyes'll light up for sure, 
right? 
Like—"Blast, you're amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Mother Holding Baby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for last year. 
...Thanks to the safe delivery charm you 
gave me that day, 
my little one was born healthy and sound!
—My eyes met <chrname>'s beside me.
...That was our answer.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—Tradition holds that it was after this 
event 
that festivals and sacred rituals held 
alongside humans multiplied.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...So that's why the Soaring Gallop and 
Yabusame 
are the way they are.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...It's best when we're together with 
humans. 
Because human prayers become a horsegirl's 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: The prayers of you all, dreaming upon us!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can make this ritual a 
success! 
A roaring success! Right, Trainer?!

I met her expectant smile head-on. 
—Silently reaffirming my wish to stay by 
their side, 
supporting them no matter how far the road 
ahead leads.
